title: Notils Project Configuration
description: Configuration for projects managed by the Notils CLI. Written by create-notils at scaffold time, or by `notils init` in an existing project. See https://github.com/notils/create-notils.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor validation.

shape.description: The project layout. `monorepo` has workspaces with packages under `paths.packages`; `standalone` is a single Next.js app where everything resolves through the `@/*` alias.

scope.description: The project's own npm package scope, with the leading `@` and no trailing slash (e.g. `@my-app`). Monorepo only — `add` writes imports in this scope. Null for standalone, which has no scope.

paths.description: Where generated code goes. `packages` applies to a monorepo; `lib` and `components` apply to a standalone project.

packages.description: Workspace packages root, relative to the project root. Monorepo only.

lib.description: Where folded library packages go, relative to the project root. Standalone only.

components.description: Where UI components go, relative to the project root. Standalone only.

apps.description: Where applications live, relative to the project root. Monorepo only — used by `notils add app`.

installed.description: Which packages `notils add` has written, and from which template ref, so `notils list` can report drift. Absent means unknown (e.g. packages that came from the scaffold), never "nothing installed".

ref.description: The template ref this package's source came from, e.g. "v0.5.0".
